steps.text: Ship board, {side} side up, with the ship action token, 3 coins and 1 grain
Captain Sofi Odessa crew board in the middle; split the other 8 crew boards evenly among players; synergy tokens nearby
Shuffle the ability deck by the ship board
Event deck: 6 random deadly, then 6 perilous, then 6 mild on top (18 cards) on the ship board
Starting adventure cards Gloria, Soup, Gear and Flapjacks (from the market deck) by the ship board; card box nearby
Enemy deck, quest and adventure decks nearby - never reorder or browse them
Storybook near the board; shuffle the search tokens facedown in a stack
Each player (not each crew member) takes 1 command and 1 ability card
Level cards and all other tokens near the ship board; a new journey log sheet
Choose the first player and give them the captain token
